methodology.displayName: Threshold Sign-On activation, public-signal, and completed-action methodology v2

estimandDefinitions.success_case_additional: Other qualifying signatures made effective at activation and, separately, other required public actions completed. These are distinct native-unit outcomes.
estimandDefinitions.expected_additional: The validated change in activation or completed-action probability caused by the focal qualifying signature, multiplied by the corresponding other-signature or action quantity.
estimandDefinitions.direct_causal_attribution: The focal signer's marginal effect under the validated signature-arrival and completion design. It defaults to non-additive and is not summed with cooperative allocation.
estimandDefinitions.verified_outcome: Two separately keyed outcome components: signatures atomically activated or revealed, and public acts actually completed. Signature count is impact only when the frozen objective is the public signal itself.
estimandDefinitions.cooperative_allocation: A non-additive Shapley allocation of the relevant frozen coalition outcome across qualifying signers.

methodology.baselineDefinition: Before the first signature, freeze proposition, objective type, threshold, eligibility, deadline, withdrawal, expiry, risk, reveal policy, required public act, and each eligible participant's no-threshold plan.

causalIdentificationPolicy.estimand: The causal estimand is the change in threshold activation and separately in completed public actions under the focal signature's presence versus absence at the same pre-exposure signer state.
admissibleDesigns: randomized invitation or reminder with cluster-aware spillover analysis
pre-specified threshold or eligibility discontinuity with interference-aware estimand
causalIdentificationPolicy.interferencePolicy: Model how one signature affects later signatures, withdrawals, reveal decisions, and action completion. Pre-specify the exposure mapping and preserve privacy.
causalIdentificationPolicy.overlapAndPositivityPolicy: Estimate causal effects only in states with empirical support for both the with-participant and without-participant conditions. Fail closed when overlap or positivity is materially violated.
causalIdentificationPolicy.sensitivityAnalysisPolicy: Report pre-specified sensitivity analyses for unmeasured confounding, baseline misclassification, and interference. Withhold causal components when conclusions are not robust to the approved bounds.

evidenceSemanticsPolicy.publicCopyRule: Evidence may establish that an outcome occurred and its quantity. It must not be described as verified impact or verified additionality; causal additionality remains an assessed model output.

strategicBehaviorPolicy.baselineAntecedenceRule: A baseline can support additionality only when its material evidence predates the participant-facing offer or commitment and survives post-resolution consistency checks.
strategicBehaviorPolicy.strategicTimingRule: Freeze the signer state before exposure and detect coordinated timing, duplicate accounts, and near-deadline withdrawals.
strategicBehaviorPolicy.interferenceRule: Model how one signature affects later signatures, withdrawals, reveal decisions, and action completion. Pre-specify the exposure mapping and preserve privacy.
strategicBehaviorPolicy.perverseIncentiveRule: Reject propositions that incentivize threats, coercion, or artificial escalation to attract signatures.

methodology.algorithmDescription: Predict qualifying signature arrivals, withdrawals, activation, and post-activation completion separately. Estimate causal effects only with a validated interference-aware design. At resolution, record activated signatures separately from completed acts. Do not treat signatures as substantive impact unless the frozen objective is the public signal.

referenceClassPolicy.uncertaintyExpansionRule: Reference classes support outcome prediction, not causal identification. Expand the 80% predictive interval at every approved broadening step and withhold when no defensible class remains.

uncertaintyPolicy.method: Use a pre-specified hierarchical predictive model and propagate parameter, outcome, baseline, interference, and measurement uncertainty by posterior or repeated-sampling simulation.
uncertaintyPolicy.confidencePolicy: The initial sample-size and calibration cutoffs are provisional governance floors. Low or moderate confidence may be shown only after a current health pass. High confidence is forbidden until temporal or otherwise independent holdout validation and uncertainty-aware calibration criteria are approved.

requiredBeforeHighConfidence: pre-registered temporal or otherwise independent holdout evaluation
uncertainty intervals for calibration intercept, slope, and interval coverage
documented robustness to approved confounding and interference sensitivity analyses

requiredCalibrationMetrics: out-of-sample probability calibration intercept and slope with uncertainty
out-of-sample Brier or proper scoring-rule result
blockedConditions: causal identification design is not validated
empirical calibration evidence is absent or ineligible
required state is missing or does not match the immutable state hash
input is outside the approved domain
unresolved evidence-integrity, duplication, or overlap failure
available modeled component would be published under blocked, warning, or stale health
warningConditions: reference class broadened beyond the narrowest approved class
material reliance on participant attestation rather than independent outcome evidence
calibration drift remains within a non-blocking warning band

sourceDataRequirements: immutable proposition, objective, threshold, eligibility, risk, reveal, withdrawal, and expiry terms
privacy-preserving signer ledger and stable deduplication keys
knownFailureModes: signature count is mistaken for completed action
duplicate humans or stale credentials inflate support
signers would have acted without threshold protection
one signature changes other arrivals or withdrawals
private manifest leaks identities before threshold
direct and cooperative effects are added
outOfDomainConditions: illegal, violent, deceptive, harassing, coercive, or prohibited proposition
required action is unobservable or unbounded
materialChangeTriggers: causal-identification design or sensitivity-analysis policy changes
evidence semantics or public outcome-label changes
provisional validation thresholds or high-confidence rule changes

aggregationPolicy.additiveClaimRequirement: A causal component may enter an additive caused-total only when every underlying resource or action has a stable unique claim reference and no claim reference appears in another additive component.
aggregationPolicy.overlapHandling: Outcome quantities may appear in explanatory views but verified outcomes are not caused totals. Direct marginal effects default to non-additive. Cooperative allocation is an alternative lens. Any additive causal aggregate requires unique claim references and must reject overlap.

shapleyPolicy.characteristicFunctionDefinition: For each qualifying signer subset, coalition value is either the protected public signal activated or the completed public actions, according to the frozen objective type, relative to the no-threshold plans.
shapleyPolicy.approximationMethod: Above 12 signers, use deterministic seeded permutations and withhold when Monte Carlo error, privacy, or coalition-monotonicity checks fail.

parameters.publicationRule: render deterministic terms and verified outcomes when valid; withhold every modeled causal component unless the exact active model has a current passing health snapshot
